comparison.objective: Seat both ends of a robot-vacuum brush roll and latch its retainer.
comparison.physical_skill: Align unequal end geometries into bearing and drive sockets, then close a sprung latch.
comparison.success_condition: Both ends are seated, retainer latched, roll stable, and grippers clear.
comparison.reason: It tests keyed bimanual insertion and latching rather than threaded stop adjustment.
